title: FBS Core Metadata Schema v1.0.0
description: Base schema that all FBS metadata schemas MUST incorporate by reference using allOf. Defines minimum fields required for cross-schema interoperability. RFC FBS0001 Section 4.2.4.3.

name.description: Human-readable product name, provided in at least one of the languages listed in 'languages'.

brand.description: Brand or trade name under which the product is marketed. Omit if the product is unbranded.

languages.description: List of BCP 47 language tags for the languages in which this metadata is provided. All language-dependent fields MUST be provided in at least the first listed language.

url.description: HTTPS URL at which the image is accessible

role.description: Semantic role of the image. 'primary' is the main product image. 'label' is an image of the product label. 'packaging' is the outer packaging. 'detail' is a close-up. 'alternate' is any other supplementary view.

hash.description: SHA-256 content hash of the image file, formatted as 'sha256:' followed by 64 lowercase hex characters

images.description: Product images. At most one SHOULD carry role 'primary'.

countryOfOrigin.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for the country in which the product was manufactured or primarily assembled.

description.description: Free-text product description in the primary language of the record.
